newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Oppenheim acquires 60 pct of Montgomery Govett.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheim acquires 60 pct of Montgomery Govett.

text.p: German private bank Sal Oppenheim Jun. & Cie has acquired 60 percent of Montgomery Govett, the independent Irish investment manager said on Monday.
This includes the 40 percent stake held by AIB Asset Management since its acquisition of John Govett in 1995, Montgomery Govett said in a statement.
The remaining 40 percent of the Irish firm is held by managing director Paul Montgomery and two investment managers.
The new company will be called Montgomery Oppenheim Ltd.

"We are confident that this partnership with Oppenheim will provide us with complementary expertise to further strengthen our global resources and enable us to look forward to the opportunities that will arise in our industry when Ireland joins EMU," Paul Montgomery said.
